Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-01 Idraulica, idrologia, costruzioni idrauliche e marittime

Assessment of changes in sub-hourly precipitation extremes across the Veneto Region under climate change. ARPAV records will be complemented with rain-gauge observations from ANBI-associated land reclamation consortia. At least nine convection-permitting climate models (CPMs) will be analysed for the historical period 1996–2005 and the future horizons 2041–2050 and 2090–2099 under RCP8.5.
